title: RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating embodied-AI policies in closed loop across simulation benchmarks such as LIBERO and RoboTwin requires repeated integration, as each benchmark defines its own evaluator, observation layout, and action convention. Evaluation can also be slow: with a StarVLA checkpoint, the 5,000 episodes of RoboTwin Easy take 17.5 hours on four RTX PRO 5000 GPUs. Profiling the official StarVLA evaluators identifies two bottlenecks: alternating between one simulator and inference leaves the GPU at only 14.3% average utilization on LIBERO-Long, while rendering at every control step on RoboTwin means an action-chunk policy reads only one of every 16 rendered observations. We present RoboScope Kit, an evaluation toolkit that integrates each model and benchmark once through a unified interface, keeping each benchmark's native evaluator and scoring, and accelerates evaluation through two mechanisms. translated_title: RoboScope Kit：面向快速且可扩展的具身智能评估的统一接口
translated_abstract: 在诸如 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 等仿真基准上对具身智能策略进行闭环评估需要反复集成，因为每个基准都定义了各自的评估器、观测布局和动作约定。评估过程也可能非常缓慢：使用 StarVLA 检查点，RoboTwin Easy 的 5,000 个回合在四块 RTX PRO 5000 GPU 上需要 17.5 小时。对官方 StarVLA 评估器的性能分析揭示了两个瓶颈：在单个模拟器与推理之间交替运行导致 GPU 在 LIBERO-Long 上的平均利用率仅为 14.3%，而 RoboTwin 上每个控制步都进行渲染意味着动作块策略仅读取每 16 个渲染观测中的 1 个。我们提出了 RoboScope Kit，这是一个评估工具包，它通过统一接口对每个模型和基准只需集成一次，同时保留各基准的原生评估器和评分方式，并通过两种机制加速评估：(1) 调度：模拟器工作进程与策略……
tldr: RoboScope Kit 是一个具身智能评估工具包，通过统一接口实现模型与基准的一次性集成，并借助调度与渲染优化机制大幅加速闭环评估。
en_tdlr: RoboScope Kit is an evaluation toolkit that integrates models and benchmarks once through a unified interface and accelerates closed-loop embodied-AI evaluation via scheduling and rendering optimizations.
